hooks.name: Secret Scan on Stop
hooks.description: Scans git-modified files for hardcoded AWS credentials, API keys, and secrets when a session ends. Prints a warning for any file that matches known secret patterns.

action.command: git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$' | xargs grep -lEn 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ASIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|aws_secret_access_key\s*=\s*\S+|aws_session_token\s*=\s*\S+|-----BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE KEY-----|(?i)(api[_-]?key|secret[_-]?key|access[_-]?token)\s*[:=]\s*["\x27]?[A-Za-z0-9/+]{20,}' 2>/dev/null | while read file; do echo "WARNING: possible hardcoded secret detected in $file — please review before committing"; done
